arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالعٰدِيٰتِ ضَبحًا

translation: And scouring to the raid at dawn
Then, therewith, with their trail of dust
Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe)
Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
And lo! he is a witness unto that
And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent

arabic: أَفَلا يَعلَمُ إِذا بُعثِرَ ما فِى القُبورِ
transliteration: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori
translation: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
And the secrets of the breasts are made known
On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them
